families.title: Capture & commit
families.description: Record ideas and performances, choose microphone placement and monitoring, and decide what to print or retain.

families.title: Build a groove
families.description: Shape rhythmic feel through playing, loop editing, percussion placement and the interaction of bass and drums.

families.title: Shape a sound
families.description: Change tone through instrument setup, synthesis, filtering, distortion and signal order.

families.title: Create space
families.description: Use ambience, vocal doubles, panning and effects routing to create depth, width and movement.

families.title: Control dynamics
families.description: Shape envelopes, compression and limiting while preserving the intended impact.

families.title: Choose & arrange
families.description: Develop ideas, choose layers and sections, test alternatives and judge a mix in context.

priority_definitions.1: Directly actionable, specific production method; exact settings are not required when the action itself is clear.
priority_definitions.2: Supporting practice, creative principle or useful production observation.
priority_definitions.3: Gear identification, unresolved attribution, working conditions or historical context without a sufficiently established method.

notes.note: Editorial classification only: merge by claim ID without rewriting claims, sources, era, gear or evidence. Priority measures practical usefulness, not confidence. Existing qualifications remain mandatory at every priority.

Snare-side microphone placement belongs to capture; compressor envelope controls belong to dynamics; interacting kick/snare feel belongs to groove. MW2-05 is supporting practice because it establishes envelope importance without a specific adjustment.
These concern choosing tools to change creative habits or reduce friction, so decisions is more useful than a gear-oriented sound category.

Processing whose stated purpose is tonal coloration belongs to sound, including EQ before compression. Dynamics is reserved for envelope, impact and limiting. A named distortion plugin without an established method remains supporting practice or gear context.
Reverb before distortion spans sound and space; choose space because the distinctive result is transformed ambience. Favourite-pedal identification stays priority 3.
The specific first-take loop operation is groove priority 1. Retaining demos and imperfections without a specific editing method is capture priority 2.
Layering and trimming are established actions. The phase-alignment account establishes a difficulty but no solved alignment method; MW2-09 therefore stays priority 2.
Recall consequences belong to capture. Do not promote the editorial recommendation to print stems into a method attributed directly to Parker.

Double tracking used for shimmer or width belongs to space. Contrasting a single hook against doubled verses is a section-arrangement decision. Whisper width retains its filtering and compression details.

Each spans multiple families: tentative vocal reverb/compressor identification is filed under space as gear context; Fridmann's broader processing lessons are filed under dynamics as supporting practice. Neither supplies a definitive recipe.
Bus-processing claims belong to dynamics. The two disputed compressor accounts remain priority 3; the qualified broader processing order is supporting practice, not a verified fixed chain.
Monitoring belongs to decisions because it supports judgment. Bedroom conditions are context; checking another room or bringing a reference into the session are actionable methods.
Re-recording stereo piano to preserve an intimate perspective is capture. The stool sound's relationship to the opening is arrangement, despite being room sound.
The synchronized machine jam is groove; routing an 808 through an amp is sound; contrasting a freely played lead with sequenced repetition is decisions. Instrument names do not determine the family.

These remain priority 1 because the practical action is specific even though precise compressor settings, tape model, a modulation detail or retrospective context may be unknown. Do not remove those uncertainties.

website_usefulness.criteria: Editorial most-to-least-useful reading order for a general production session, not an objective score or evidence rating. Favor broad musical impact, a concrete action and adaptability with available tools; then specialized methods, supporting practices, overlapping examples and equipment or historical context. Preserve every source qualification. The best note for a particular song may be elsewhere in the list.
rationale: The opening notes cover reference listening, arrangement focus, capturing ideas, bass/drum interaction, groove and vocal space across several technique families.

Broadly useful judgment practices may precede a priority-1 method that needs a particular recording setup. Coarse priorities still organize the master guide; family order does not determine website usefulness.
Keep every claim ID exactly once. When adding a note, place it deliberately among comparable methods; do not append it automatically or infer usefulness from its ID, source, era or equipment.
